scientificLimits: The 275 pm catalogue size is an approximate characteristic reference. It is separate from the nuclear geometry and the illustrated atom radii.
Nuclear centers use the cited equilibrium O-H length of 0.9578 angstrom and H-O-H angle of 104.4776 degrees.
Atom surfaces and bond widths are illustration guides. They do not depict an electron density, literal atomic boundaries, or spatially resolved charge.
The chemical polarity arrow points toward the more negative oxygen; the physical electric dipole vector uses the opposite convention. Arrow length is not a dipole measurement.
The isolated molecular geometry does not model liquid-water hydrogen bonding, thermal motion or molecular orbitals.
